Employee Summary

The Employee Summary form configures parameters for employee payroll reports.

Set date ranges and employee filters to analyze payroll data.

Employee

Select a specific employee to generate a summary for that individual, or leave blank to include all employees.

From

The starting date for the period covered by the report.

To

The ending date for the period covered by the report.

Exclude zero balances

When checked, employees with zero balances will be excluded from the report.
